description: A very quiet location in the middle of a natural reserve in the Netherlands called “De Kampina Heiden en Vennen” (So play on a very low volume). It is an area of heathland and fens. Not many birds can be heard on this March day. For me this makes the recording special. More here today / More around here during the year Date/time: March 27th Wednesday 2019, start 11:16 am Weather: 10c, clouded, wind WNW 2bft with gusts to 10 km/h, 1034 hPa, humidity 63%.
